meta.name: pitch-position
meta.description: Produce a complete positioning document using the Dunford framework — competitive alternatives, unique attributes, value, best-fit customer, market category, positioning statement, and tagline. Use when asked to "write our positioning", "define our value prop", "positioning statement", "what market are we in", "how do we position against X", "what's our tagline", or "write our messaging foundation".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用Dunford框架写出你的市场定位、价值主张和标语
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果产品需要清晰的市场定位和竞争策略
copy.tagline_en: Write your positioning, value prop, and tagline using the Dunford framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your product needs a clear market position and competitive strategy

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会直接生成一份完整的定位文档，包含竞争替代品、独特属性、价值、最佳客户、市场类别、定位陈述和标语。它不引导用户，而是产出可直接用于后续环节的文档。
howto.when: 当你要求“写我们的定位”、“定义我们的价值主张”、“定位陈述”、“我们处于什么市场”等时触发。

say.text: 为我们的AI客服产品写一份定位文档。
请基于Dunford框架生成我们的定位陈述。
对比我们的主要竞争对手，帮我提炼独特价值。
say.note: Claude会分析竞争替代品并输出价值声明。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will directly produce a complete positioning document including competitive alternatives, unique attributes, value, best-fit customer, market category, positioning statement, and tagline. It outputs the document without coaching the user.
howto.when_en: Triggered when asked to "write our positioning", "define our value prop", "positioning statement", "what market are we in", etc.

say_en.text: Write a positioning document for our AI customer service product.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the full document.

say_en.text: Generate our positioning statement based on the Dunford framework.
Help me distill unique value against our main competitor.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze alternatives and output value claims.
